review: 1:2–1:3 עֵמֶק הַבֶּכִי / מְקוֹר הַשִּׂמְחָה — Psalm 84:7 (עֵמֶק הַבָּכָא) answered by the fountain; the Arabic وَادِي الدُّمُوع / يَنْبُوعَ السُّرُور is that psalm's movement, and Hebrew keeps both nouns.
2:4 טוֹב מְלַוֶּה — 'the best of companions', for نِعْمَ الرَّفِيق; the Arabic nعْمَ construction has no Hebrew equivalent, so the adjective carries the superlative as in hymns 38 and 75.
5:2 הוֹי אֲדֹנָי הַסּוֹלֵחַ — 'O forgiving Lord'; the Arabic الرَّبُّ الْغَفُور is the divine name of Ex 34:7 (נֹשֵׂא עָוֺן), and סוֹלֵחַ is its participle.
3:3–3:4 מֵתִים וְחַיִּים … יְקַבֵּץ — 1 Thessalonians 4:16–17; the Arabic مَوْتَى وَأَحْيَا كُلَّنَا / يَجْمَعُنَا is that gathering, and קִבֵּץ is the biblical verb for ingathering.
